solves: Lets the person search, sort, select and act on records in a table, with a toolbar above it, the bulk action bar in its place while rows are selected, row actions and pagination.
use_when: For lists of records that the person searches, sorts or filters, such as people by unit.
Bulk selection when there is an action on several rows at once, such as download or delete.
Row actions in the more when the row has more than one action.
Ajuste when the person turns a value of the row on or off without opening another screen.
Size large on a touch screen or for reading with more air; default in the other cases.
do_not_use_when: To only read and compare data, without searching, sorting or selecting: use nph-table.
To lay out the page: the table holds records.
With a search that finds nothing and a blank body: use the empty by search state.
To mark a row by the background alone: select it, with the box checked too.

size.constraint: As in nph-table: the row in table/row-height or table/row-height-large. Large is for touch or reading with more air. A value outside the list draws nothing.

framed.constraint: As in nph-table, the Figma moldura: the border and the corner of the scroll area, for a table standing alone on the page.

sticky-header.constraint: As in nph-table, the Figma cabeçalho fixo: the body scrolls under the header, which stays.

striped.constraint: As in nph-table, the Figma faixa of the row: every other row on the stripe background.

grid.constraint: As in nph-table, the Figma grade: the vertical line between the columns of the body.

caption.constraint: As in nph-table, the Figma legenda and texto da legenda: the title above the table, already localized, which names it.

description.constraint: As in nph-table, the Figma descrição: the line under the caption title. Only with a caption.

total.constraint: As in nph-table, the Figma total: an nph-badge secondary beside the caption title. With a single page, it carries the total in place of the footer.

label.constraint: As in nph-table: the accessible name of a table without a caption.

no-value-label.constraint: As in nph-table: what the screen reader reads in the no-value dash, such as sem valor.

empty-heading.constraint: As in nph-table: the heading of the nph-empty when there is no row. In empty by search, it says the searched term, already written by the consumer.

empty-description.constraint: As in nph-table: the description of the nph-empty when there is no row.

columns.constraint: Property only. The columns of nph-table, each with key, header, align, group and width, plus sortable: the header becomes a button that sorts the column. The order of the columns comes from the data. An invalid list draws nothing, as in nph-table.

rows.constraint: Property only. The rows of nph-table, with key, cells, detail, open, loading and toggleLabel, plus name, the record that fills {name}, and switched, the state of the ajuste. They arrive already searched, sorted and paged: the table cuts or orders nothing. A row with children is drawn without them and emits console.error in development.

footer.constraint: As in nph-table: a value per column key, drawn with the background of the header.

sort-key.constraint: The key of the sorted column, with sort-direction. A key that is not a sortable column draws no column sorted and warns in development.

sort-direction.constraint: The direction of the column of sort-key, the value of its aria-sort. Empty, no column is sorted. A value outside the list draws no column sorted and emits console.error in development.

selectable.constraint: Adds the selection column, with an nph-checkbox in the header and in each row. It needs select-all-label and select-label; without them the column is left out and the table emits console.error in development.

selected.constraint: Property only. The keys of the selected rows, the ones on other pages too. The table changes it when the person checks a box.

select-all-label.constraint: The name of the header box, already localized, such as Selecionar todas.

select-label.constraint: The name of a row box, with the {name} marker filled by the row name, such as Selecionar {name}. A row without name has no box and the table emits console.error in development.

selected-text.constraint: The count of the bulk bar, with the {count} and {total} markers, filled with the numbers in the language of the page, such as {count} de {total} selecionadas. The table writes it as the count-text of the nph-toolbar in the slot bulk. {total} is total-items, or the rows drawn without it.

actions.constraint: Property only. The entries of the nph-dropdown-menu that the more of each row opens, with Delete last in destructive. Empty, there is no actions column. It needs actions-label.

actions-label.constraint: The name of the more of a row, with {name}, such as Mais ações de {name}. Without it the actions column is left out and the table emits console.error in development.

switch-header.constraint: The title of the ajuste column, already localized. Empty, there is no ajuste column. It needs switch-label.

switch-label.constraint: The name of the nph-switch of a row, with {name}. Without it the ajuste column is left out and the table emits console.error in development.

loading.constraint: The Figma estado carregando: an nph-skeleton in the cells of data, as many rows as the rows shown or the page size, with the header visible and the header box disabled.

clear-label.constraint: The Figma estado vazio pela busca: with no row and an empty-heading, the body holds the nph-empty and an nph-button with this text, such as Limpar filtro, data-table/empty-gap apart. Empty, an empty body is the one of nph-table.

page.constraint: The current page, a whole number from 1. The table changes it when the person moves.

page-size.constraint: The items per page, a whole number from 1. Required for the footer. The table changes it when the person picks another size, and the first item on screen stays on screen.

page-sizes.constraint: The options of items per page, whole numbers from 1. As an attribute, a JSON list. Without it, the footer has no items per page.

total-items.constraint: The total of records, a whole number from 0. Required for the footer; with no more than one page, there is no footer.

pagination-layout.constraint: The footer for the width of the table's space (pending decision D-1): wide is the nph-pagination tipo tabela; middle, the label and the nph-select of items per page and tipo intervalo; narrow, tipo intervalo only. A value outside the list leaves the footer out and emits console.error in development.

pagination-label.constraint: The label of the nph-pagination, the name of its navigation.

page-label.constraint: The page-label of the nph-pagination, with {page}.

first-label.constraint: The first-label of the nph-pagination; required in wide.

last-label.constraint: The last-label of the nph-pagination; required in wide.

position-text.constraint: The position-text of the nph-pagination, with {start}, {end} and {total}.

page-size-label.constraint: The visible label of items per page, which names its nph-select, in data-table/page-size-label-foreground. In wide it goes to the nph-pagination.

toolbar.constraint: One nph-toolbar tipo página, with the search, the filter and the table actions. It stays outside the scroll area and leaves its place to the bulk bar while a row is selected.

bulk.constraint: One nph-toolbar tipo em massa, with its actions and without its own checkbox: the select-all box stays in the table header. It shows while a row is selected.

action.constraint: As in nph-table: the main action of the caption.

nph-sort-change.constraint: Fired when the person sorts, with detail { key, direction }. A column that was not sorted goes ascending, and the sorted one turns around (pending decision D-3). Bubbles, not composed; setting the sort from code fires nothing.

nph-selection-change.constraint: Fired when the person checks or unchecks a box, with detail { selected }. The header box checks or unchecks the rows drawn (pending decision D-4). Bubbles, not composed.

nph-row-action.constraint: The event of nph-table, with detail { row, action }: also when the person picks an entry of the menu of the more, with action the value of the entry.

nph-row-toggle.constraint: As in nph-table: the person opened or closed a row by its chevron, with detail { row, open }.

nph-row-switch.constraint: Fired when the person turns the nph-switch of a row, with detail { row, checked }. The consumer keeps switched in the row. Bubbles, not composed.

nph-filter-clear.constraint: Fired when the person activates the button of the empty by search state. The consumer clears the search and passes the rows again. Bubbles, not composed.

nph-page-change.constraint: Fired when the person moves in the footer, with detail { page, pageSize }: the one of the nph-pagination, and the same one from the items per page of the middle footer. Bubbles and composed.

default.choose_when: A screen with a pointer and a dense reading.

large.choose_when: A touch screen or a reading with more air.

framed.choose_when: A table standing alone on the page.

sticky-header.choose_when: A long list: the body scrolls and the column titles stay.

sorted.changes_for_user: The sorted header shows the arrow of the direction in the active color; the other sortable headers show the two-way arrow in data-table/sort-icon-foreground.

focus.changes_for_user: The sortable header takes the ring in table/focus-ring-width inside the cell, around the label and the arrow; the scroll area takes it as in nph-table.

selected.changes_for_user: The row takes the selected background and the mark data-table/row-selected-indicator in data-table/row-selected-indicator-width at the inline start, with its box checked.

hover.changes_for_user: The whole row under the pointer, as in nph-table; a selected row keeps its background.

bulk.changes_for_user: While a row is selected, the bulk bar takes the place of the page bar and says how many rows are selected.

loading.changes_for_user: The cells of data hold an nph-skeleton line and the header stays visible.

empty.changes_for_user: A search that finds nothing shows the nph-empty with the searched term and the button that clears it, with the header visible.

business_rules: The data is controlled: the rows arrive already searched, sorted and paged, and the table says what the person chose in events.
A click on a column that is not sorted sorts it ascending; on the sorted column, it turns the direction around (pending decision D-3).
The header box checks and unchecks the rows drawn on the page; rows selected on other pages stay selected (pending decision D-4).
The bulk bar shows while one row or more is selected, in place of the page bar, with the count.
When the selection empties while the focus is in the bulk bar, the focus goes to the header box.
The footer stays outside the scroll area; with a single page, there is no footer and the total goes to the caption.
The footer follows pagination-layout, set by the consumer for the width of the space, until the breakpoint tokens exist (pending decision D-1).
The ajuste column sits at the end of the row, before the actions (pending decision D-6).
ai_hints: Use nph-data-table when the person searches, sorts, selects or acts on records; to only read and compare data, use nph-table.
Pass rows already searched, sorted and paged, and listen to nph-sort-change, nph-selection-change and nph-page-change to pass them again.
Give each row a name, the record that fills {name} in the names of its box, its more and its switch.
Put an nph-toolbar tipo página in slot toolbar and an nph-toolbar tipo em massa, without its checkbox, in slot bulk.
Mark a number column with align end, in the cell and in the header, and make it sortable when the person compares values.
Name the search after what it filters, such as Filtrar por pessoa.
Use the empty by search state with clear-label when a search finds nothing; never leave the body blank.
Choose pagination-layout by the width of the space: wide from the table's own items per page, middle in between, narrow on a phone.

accessibility.semantics: The native table of nph-table. The sorted header carries aria-sort; the sortable header is a native button the size of the cell. The selection, actions and ajuste headers of the boxes and of the more are cells of the header row, not column headers.
accessibility.accessible_name: The caption names the table. The header box is named select-all-label; each row box, select-label with the row name; each more, actions-label with the row name; each switch, switch-label with the row name. The sortable header is named by its title.
keyboard: Tab reaches the sortable headers, the boxes, the switches, the more of each row and the pieces of the footer, in order; the row takes no focus
Enter and Space sort from a sortable header and check a box
The more opens its nph-dropdown-menu with Enter, Space or the down arrow, with the keyboard of that menu
A header that does not sort takes no focus
accessibility.focus: The sortable header takes the ring focus/border in table/focus-ring-width inside the cell, around the label and the arrow. The scroll area takes the ring of nph-table. The boxes, the switches, the more, the bars and the footer use the focus of their own piece.
accessibility.contrast: Text and link pass AA over the background, the stripe, the hover, the selected row and the bulk bar, in light and dark. The sort arrow and the selected row mark pass 3:1. The unchecked box border in data-table/checkbox-border passes 3:1 over the background, the header, the stripe and the hover.
accessibility.color_alternative: The selected row has its box checked and the mark at the start, besides the background. The sort shows the arrow in the direction, not only the color. The bulk bar says how many rows are selected. Empty by search explains in text.

invalid_combinations: What nph-table rejects — a size outside the list, no column, a column without key or header, a repeated key — draws nothing.
A sort-direction outside ascending and descending — no column is drawn sorted.
A pagination-layout outside wide, middle and narrow — the footer is left out.
A row with children — the children are left out: the tree is nph-table's.
selectable without select-all-label or select-label, actions without actions-label, switch-header without switch-label — that column is left out.
A row without name next to boxes, more or switches — its controls are left out.
anti_patterns: Leaving a search with no result with a blank body.
Marking the row by the background alone, with the box empty.
Sorting, filtering or cutting the list inside the table: the rows arrive ready.
Putting the select-all box in the bulk bar: it stays in the table header.
Using the data table to only read and compare data.
